title: Bias Testing and Mitigation in Black Box LLMs using Metamorphic Relations
findings: Metamorphic Relations (MRs), specifically 'Similarity Preamble' (MR4) and 'Attribute Flip' (MR5), were found to be statistically significant in exposing hidden biases related to religion. Fine-tuning models with data augmented by these MRs substantially improved bias resiliency for the religion category across all models tested. For instance, LLaMA 3.1-8B-Instruct's resiliency in the religion category improved from a baseline of 77.4% to 99.7% after fine-tuning.
